policy: V23 adds a fee-budgeted owner-distribution handoff above distribution.available-capacity/v2. Beneficiary principal and payer-borne external settlement fees are distinct economics. For every exact batch, principal_total + external_fee_budget must not exceed the current Financial OS final_available_capacity. MetaPay may later spend less fee than the budget but may never reduce beneficiary principal to pay a fee or exceed the authorized fee/outflow ceiling. Legacy distribution Plan/Authorization/ExecutionTicket v1 remain immutable and carry zero payer-borne external-fee authority.

additions.authority_note: Non-authorizing exact beneficiary batch bound to one current distribution.available-capacity/v2. Separately states beneficiary principal and payer-borne external fee budget; principal + fee budget cannot exceed current available capacity.

Human-committee or multisig decision over the exact Plan v2 principal, fee budget and total outflow ceiling. AI authority is NONE. Authorization does not execute payment and requires a separate short-lived execution ticket before MetaPay handoff.

Short-lived final Financial OS handoff gate. Re-verifies exact current Plan v2, Authorization v2 and AvailableCapacity v2 and carries the immutable principal, fee budget and total cash-outflow ceiling. payment_authority is METAPAY_ONLY; the ticket itself has execution_authority NONE.
